steps.title: Prepare 2x CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Combine the following to make 1 L of 2× CTAB extraction buffer: 40 mL of 0.5 M EDTA (20 mM final, pH 8.0), 100 mL of 1 M Tris‑HCl (100 mM final, pH 8.0), 87.6 g NaCl (to give 1.5 M), 20 g CTAB (2 % w/v), and 10 mL β‑mercaptoethanol (1 % v/v, add fresh before use). Bring the volume to 1000 mL with distilled water.

steps.title: Lyse tissue with CTAB
steps.instruction: Add 1.5 mL of the freshly prepared 2× CTAB buffer to the plant sample, then incubate at 60 °C for 45 min, shaking gently every 10 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 12,000 rpm for 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube using wide‑bore pipette tips to avoid mechanical damage to DNA.

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Under a fume hood, add a double volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the aqueous phase, invert gently 15–20 times, then centrifuge at 12,500 rpm for 15 min. If the recovered aqueous layer is still translucent, repeat the addition and centrifugation until the layer becomes clear, taking care not to transfer any chloroform.

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add a double volume of chilled isopropanol to the cleared aqueous phase, then add one‑third volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2). Mix briefly and incubate at –20 °C for 1 h to precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 12,000 rpm for 15 min, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add chilled 70 % ethanol (double volume) to the DNA pellet, gently spool out the pellet, centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 15 min, discard supernatant, and repeat the ethanol wash once more.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard any remaining supernatant and dry the pellet by vacuum centrifugation or air drying at room temperature, ensuring no residual ethanol remains and avoiding overdrying.

steps.title: Resuspend and assess DNA
steps.instruction: Add 40–50 µL TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8) to the dried pellet, vortex briefly to dissolve, quantify DNA using a Qubit fluorometer or Nanodrop, and run a 0.8 % agarose gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA at –20 °C or –40 °C until further use.
